compliant.description: Overall posture verdict: true when the device satisfies the policy baseline. Provider-agnostic roll-up of the individual posture attributes (and any provider-specific signals not surfaced as discrete fields).

diskEncryption.description: Disk encryption posture, provider-neutral (BitLocker / FileVault / LUKS). unknown when the provider did not report it.

antivirus.description: Antivirus / endpoint-protection posture. unknown when the provider did not report it.

patch.description: OS / security patch posture. unknown when the provider did not report it.

firewall.description: Host firewall posture. unknown when the provider did not report it.

observedAt.description: Time this posture reading was determined (freshness anchor); always present — a posture verdict without a timestamp is unsafe to trust for Authorize decisions.
